title: Agent loop modularization preserves behavior and documents Codex parity

structure.title: Public runAgent entrypoint remains stable
structure.test: The agent loop refactor must keep packages/ndx/src/agent/loop.ts as the public runAgent entrypoint while moving implementation pieces into submodules.

steps.expected: The file exports runAgent and imports orchestration pieces from packages/ndx/src/agent/loop/.
The folder contains separate files for events/types, state, skills, sampling, and tool execution responsibilities.

structure.passCriteria: The public entrypoint is preserved and loop responsibilities are separated into focused files.

behavior.title: TypeScript build preserves agent loop contracts
behavior.test: The refactored files must compile under the package TypeScript configuration without changing public types.

steps.instruction: Run yarn build in the repository root after implementation.

documentation.title: OpenAI Codex loop comparison is documented
documentation.test: The implementation must include a concise durable analysis of OpenAI Codex Rust loop parity and NDX-specific boundaries.

steps.instruction: Inspect packages/ndx/docs/architecture.md and packages/ndx/docs/internals.md after implementation.
steps.expected: The docs describe the new agent loop submodules and explain which Codex Rust loop responsibilities are mirrored, deferred, or intentionally owned elsewhere in NDX.

documentation.passCriteria: Docs contain the parity analysis and module ownership contracts.

deployment.title: Deploy verification completes
deployment.test: The repository deploy contract must still complete after the agent loop refactor.

steps.instruction: Run npm run deploy from the repository root after implementation.
steps.expected: The command exits successfully or the failure is recorded with concrete blocker evidence.

deployment.passCriteria: Deploy succeeds, or any failure is recorded with command output and an explicit blocker.
